title: Faithfulness of finite-structure adjoint tests on tensor powers
statement: Let A be Noetherian and I-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Let f:X to Spec A be separated and finite type [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Put X_n = X times_{Spec A} Spec(A/I^(n+1)) and j_n:X_n to X [def-pc-base-change], and let i_n:X_n to X_(n+1) satisfy the two canonical projection equations. Let G be coherent with support proper over Spec A [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. For arbitrary schemes Y_n and maps p_n:Y_n to X_n suppose isomorphisms psi_n:j_n^*G isomorphic to p_(n,*) O_Yn [def-pc-module-pullback]. Write a_n:G to (p_n j_n)_* O_Yn for the pinned adjoint of psi_n and pushforward composition [lem-weil-pbc-finite-structure-adjoint-transitions]. (1) Maps v,w:G tensor G to G are equal if a_n(v(x tensor y)) = a_n(w(x tensor y)) for all n, opens U and x,y in G(U). (2) Maps v,w:(G tensor G) tensor G to G are equal if a_n(v((x tensor y) tensor z)) = a_n(w((x tensor y) tensor z)) for all n, opens U and x,y,z in G(U) [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. No compatibility of psi_n, finiteness of p_n, or multiplication on G is assumed. This is detection of global module morphisms, not injectivity on sections over arbitrary opens.

proof.text: The tensor square and cube are coherent with proper support. X is Noetherian, hence G is quasi-coherent.

For each n compare v followed by a_n and w followed by a_n. On an affine open every square section comes from the tensor-sections map; tensor induction extends equality from pure tensors to all sections. For the cube use surjectivity of the outer and inner tensor-sections maps and induction twice. Naturality and the sheaf condition on the covering by contained affine opens extend equality to every open, so the two composite morphisms coincide.

Cancel the invertible pushforward composition comparison from the equal composites. Express the remaining composites under the pinned tensor-pullback adjunction hom equivalence, using naturality of its unit. Injectivity of that equivalence gives equality of j_n^*v followed by psi_n and j_n^*w followed by psi_n; cancel psi_n.

Invoke the Hom full-faithfulness clause of grothendieck_existence, choosing exactly the auxiliary comparison required by its interface. Naturality makes the reductions of w a compatible family for this comparison. Both v and w lift that same family, hence the uniqueness clause equates them. No identification of the auxiliary comparison with the pinned composition mate is used.

theorem finite_structure_tensor_tests_faithful
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsAdicComplete I A]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (i : ∀ n : ℕ, pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))) ⟶
      pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))
    (hi : ∀ n : ℕ, i n ≫ pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n
      + 1 + 1))))) = pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n +
      1))))))
    (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, i n ≫ pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n
      + 1 + 1))))) = pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n +
      1))))) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I :=
      I) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))))
    (Yn : ℕ → Scheme.{u})
    (fnY : ∀ n, Yn n ⟶ pullback f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))
    (G : X.Modules) (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G)
    (hproper : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f G)
    (ψ : ∀ n, (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).obj G ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (fnY n)).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (Yn n).ringCatSheaf)) :
    (∀ (v w : G ⊗ G ⟶ G),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens) (x y : Γ(G, U)),
        (Scheme.Modules.finiteStructureAdjoint
          (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) (fnY n) G (ψ n).hom).app U
          (v.app U (tmulSection x y)) =
        (Scheme.Modules.finiteStructureAdjoint
          (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) (fnY n) G (ψ n).hom).app U
          (w.app U (tmulSection x y))) → v = w) ∧
    (∀ (v w : (G ⊗ G) ⊗ G ⟶ G),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens) (x y z : Γ(G, U)),
        (Scheme.Modules.finiteStructureAdjoint
          (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) (fnY n) G (ψ n).hom).app U
          (v.app U (tmulSection (tmulSection x y) z)) =
        (Scheme.Modules.finiteStructureAdjoint
          (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) (fnY n) G (ψ n).hom).app U
          (w.app U (tmulSection (tmulSection x y) z))) → v = w)
